author: Chris Cooley
name: Byte Runner
tagline: Follow the dots. Eat the page.
description: A pellet-filled maze grows around the page. Chase the trails, grab glowing power pellets, collect fruit, and turn the ghosts into points.
versionNote: Clear the dots. Meet the next maze.
controls: Arrows / WASD / touch D-pad — turn and follow the corridors
Queue a turn before a junction; reverse at any time
P — pause · G — next area · Esc — Recall

chapters.title: A maze across the view.
chapters.body: Small pellets mark connected corridors across the visible page. Buttons and marked page elements become walls. Clear all small and glowing pellets to earn a level bonus and build the next maze. Letters along your route are extra food: eat them into real 0s and 1s.

chapters.title: Big glow. Bigger appetite.
chapters.body: Glowing pink power pellets turn ghosts blue for six seconds, stacking up to nine. Hunt them for 100, 200, 300, then 400 points. Cherries and strawberries appear on the trails for bonus points; fruit is optional and does not grant power.

chapters.title: Classic movement, real page terrain.
chapters.body: The runner keeps moving down the current corridor. Queue a turn before a junction, or reverse immediately. Ghosts use the same corridor graph, so neither you nor an enemy can cut through a wall. One ghost chases directly, one anticipates your heading, and one mixes pursuit with roaming.

chapters.title: The DOM carries the maze.
chapters.body: The maze, pellets, fruit, and pixel sprites are native SVG children attached inside your content root. They follow scrolling and transforms even while paused. The active maze adapts to a changed viewport while preserving progress; it never earns points or clears a level by resizing.

extra: Three lives. Levels advance by clearing pellets, not by elapsed time. The roster grows from three ghosts toward a cap of eight. Recall removes the maze and restores game-owned text edits.

characters.name: Byte Runner
characters.rules: Follow the small pellets with arrows or the D-pad. Queue turns at junctions. Clear the maze to advance; letters on your route are bonus food.

characters.name: Chaser
characters.rules: The violet ghost takes a corridor route toward your position. Unpowered contact costs a life.

characters.name: Interceptor
characters.rules: The pink ghost aims several junctions ahead of your heading. Turn to change its interception point.

characters.name: Roamer
characters.rules: The cyan ghost mixes fast pursuit with roaming at junctions. It obeys the same walls you do.

characters.name: Vulnerable ghosts
characters.rules: A glowing power pellet seals the gates temporarily. Blue ghosts flee along the maze and become edible. Chain catches for increasing points.

characters.name: Power pellet
characters.rules: The large glowing dots give six seconds of power, capped at nine when stacked. They count toward clearing the maze.

characters.name: Bonus fruit
characters.rules: Cherries and strawberries appear on the corridors. Catch them before they disappear; they are optional bonus food.
